summary: IW8-031 implemented and verified. Signals-based auth session store, token interceptor with single-flight refresh, Apollo auth link, and candidate feature component all exist and pass 44/44 tests. Lint and build succeed. Component spec fixed: removed fakeAsync/tick (Vitest jsdom lacks zone.js/testing), replaced toBeFalse() with toBe(false), flushed pending HTTP requests so afterEach verify() passes.
verification: AC1: Signals-based session state: AuthSessionStore uses Angular signals (accessToken, refreshTokenHash, userId, deviceId, sessionId, persona, expiresOn) with computed isAuthenticated and sessionExpiresSoon. Verified in auth-session.store.spec.ts (6/6 tests pass).

AC2: Attach access token: auth.interceptor.ts clones requests with Authorization: Bearer header for /api/* URLs; auth-link.ts attaches Authorization header for GraphQL via SetContextLink. Verified in auth.interceptor.spec.ts and auth-link.spec.ts.

AC3: Single-flight refresh on 401/UNAUTHENTICATED: auth.interceptor.ts uses isRefreshing + BehaviorSubject refreshSubject to serialize refresh attempts; concurrent 401s wait on the same refresh and retry with new token. Verified in auth.interceptor.spec.ts.
AC4: Happy path: component spec sets mock session, triggers refresh, flushes successful response, and asserts store updated and success state rendered. Tests pass.

AC5: Loading and double-submit guard: component sets refreshInProgress before HTTP call; second trigger hits guard and shows 'Refresh already in progress...'. Pending request flushed in test so verify() passes. Test passes.
AC6: Error state from stable error code: component maps UNAUTHENTICATED response to error state with actionable message; store cleared. Test passes.

AC7: No parallel domain concept: reuses existing AuthSessionStore, AuthService, auth.interceptor, auth-link, and auth endpoints from IW8-010/IW8-028; no new tables, endpoints, or domain concepts introduced.
AC8: No forbidden data in logs: component, store, service, and interceptor specs assert console output never contains token/refresh-hash/contact values; production code has no console.log of secrets.
notes: Host-generated inventory, proof records and outbox handoff.
